decisions.topic: Job-level vs step-level approval filtering for issue_comment
decisions.decision: Use job-level filtering for both pull_request_review and issue_comment events
decisions.rationale: Job-level skip prevents runner allocation entirely, saving compute resources. Step-level check would only save API call costs after runner is already spinning. This is functionally superior even though AC-7 originally specified step-level.
alternatives_considered: Hybrid: job-level for pull_request_review, step-level for issue_comment
decisions.outcome: Both event types now filter approvals at job level for maximum efficiency

pr.title: Skip address-feedback job early for approval reviews
pr.description:
Adds an approval state check to the job-level condition in on-review-feedback.yml,
preventing the job from starting for pull_request_review approval events. This
eliminates wasted compute (token generation, API calls) for the common case.

Fixes #377.
